record.paper_title: Some of my favorite open problems
record.context_brief: Recovering Sobolev or BV norm from tail functional
record.original_question: With Φ_{λ,p}(u) defined as in q_026, is there for each 1<p<∞ a constant C=C(p,N,Ω) such that every measurable u satisfies ||∇u||_{L^p}^p ≤ C liminf_{λ→∞} λΦ_{λ,p}(u), interpreting the left side as +∞ when u∉W^{1,p}(Ω)? Similarly, for p=1, is there a constant C=C(N,Ω) such that the total variation mass ||∇u||_M is bounded by C liminf_{λ→∞} λΦ_{λ,1}(u), with +∞ if u∉BV(Ω)?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 9.2 ([32, Section 7.2]). Given any 1 < p < ∞, is there a constant C = C(p,N,Ω) such that ... ||∇u||^p_{Lp} ≤ C lim inf_{λ→∞} λ Φ_{λ,p}(u)? ... Similarly for p = 1, is there a constant C = C(N,Ω) such that ... ||∇u||_M ≤ C lim inf_{λ→∞} λ Φ_{λ,1}(u)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let Ω ⊂ ℝ^N be a smooth bounded domain and let 1 ≤ p < ∞. For a measurable function u : Ω → ℝ and λ > 0, define the super-level set of the normalized difference quotient

   E_λ(u) := { (x,y) ∈ Ω × Ω : |u(x) − u(y)| > λ |x − y|^{1 + N/p} },

and set

   Φ_{λ,p}(u) := λ^{p−1} ∫∫_{E_λ(u)} dx dy / |x − y|^N ,

so that λ Φ_{λ,p}(u) = λ^p · ∫∫_{E_λ(u)} dx dy / |x − y|^N is the weak-L^p type quantity associated with the difference-quotient kernel.

(a) For each 1 < p < ∞, does there exist a constant C = C(p, N, Ω) such that for every measurable u : Ω → ℝ one has

   ‖∇u‖_{L^p(Ω)}^p ≤ C · liminf_{λ → ∞} λ Φ_{λ,p}(u) ,

with the convention that the left-hand side equals +∞ whenever u ∉ W^{1,p}(Ω)?

(b) For p = 1, does there exist a constant C = C(N, Ω) such that for every measurable u : Ω → ℝ one has

   ‖∇u‖_{M(Ω)} ≤ C · liminf_{λ → ∞} λ Φ_{λ,1}(u) ,

where ‖∇u‖_{M(Ω)} denotes the total variation mass of the distributional gradient of u, with the convention that the left-hand side equals +∞ whenever u ∉ BV(Ω)?
artifact.status_search_result: The question concerns recovering the Sobolev W^{1,p} (resp. BV) seminorm from below using the liminf as λ→∞ of the weak-L^p-type tail functional of Brezis–Van Schaftingen–Yung. Related work (Poliakovsky 2021, Brezis–Seeger–Van Schaftingen–Yung 2024, recent characterization papers from 2025) extends the formula and obtains lower bounds in various regimes, but no source found establishes the desired universal lower bound for all measurable functions in the liminf form stated, and it continues to appear as an open problem in surveys.

status_evidence.title: Some remarks on a formula for Sobolev norms due to Brezis, Van Schaftingen and Yung (Poliakovsky)
status_evidence.snippet: Addresses questions raised by Brezis, Van Schaftingen and Yung concerning the Gagliardo-type semi-norm; treats weak L^q replacements but leaves liminf lower bounds open in generality.
status_evidence.claim: Related lower-bound questions are explicitly identified as open.

status_evidence.title: Families of functionals representing Sobolev norms
status_evidence.snippet: Studies functionals of BVY type and their relationship to Sobolev/BV norms.
status_evidence.claim: The precise liminf lower bound recovering ||∇u||_{L^p}^p (resp. BV norm) is not established in full generality.

status_evidence.title: Characterizations of the Sobolev norms and the total variation via super-level set functionals
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) work refining BVY-type characterizations including weak-type formulations; lists remaining open lower-bound questions.
status_evidence.claim: The desired universal liminf lower bound remains an open problem.
